1.title: Trump Administration Asks Supreme Court to Greenlight White House Ballroom
1.summary: The planned 90,000-square-foot ballroom is estimated to cost $400 million and is part of the president’s broader effort to remake Washington in his own style.

2.title: ‘A Dying Community’: An Energy Crisis Worsened by the War Strains Alaska
2.summary: Diesel generators produce the electricity for small towns and hamlets like Manley Hot Springs, Alaska. Prices are soaring with no end in sight.

3.title: Brad Pitt’s Return to Drinking Is Not Unsafe, Experts Say
3.summary: His disclosure in an interview revived a key question about sobriety: whether someone who once drank dangerously can ever drink moderately.

4.title: Kevin Rideout, American Missionary Kidnapped in Niger, Is Released
4.summary: Kevin Rideout, a pilot, was abducted from his home in the country’s capital, Niamey, last fall. His mission organization said he was in “good health” after his release.

5.title: Russia Campaigned to Derail Moldova’s Pro-Western Government
5.summary: In the tiny nation, Moscow paid Orthodox priests, conducted a vote-buying scheme and set up training camps on election interference — all in an effort to derail the Western-leaning government.

6.title: With Trump’s Hamas Deal in Peril, Kushner Set to Visit Israel for Gaza Talks
6.summary: Jared Kushner, President Trump’s senior aide, is expected to meet with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel, who has rejected a U.S.-backed deal to disarm Hamas.
